text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few weeks have passed since our info session at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The reboot project is chugging along.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: We're starting the day off with our petition again. Let's get some more signatures, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Order received. I will make further progress on this mission.

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Um, e-excuse me?

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: Sorry to butt in, but could we help out too?!

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Hearing what Hello and Tachyon said the other day really got us thinking.

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: I know you're probably like, so now you want to help? But, well…

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: We want to make the Grand Concert happen!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! Mind if we pitch in too? If it's just getting signatures, we can do that.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: And if you need more hands on deck, I can call in some friends! Please, let me do my part!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh, you guys!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Wow, I never expected we'd get this many signatures in just one hour!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um, the extra sheets just got here. If anyone's free, I could use some help carrying them.

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text: …Maybe I could help with that?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: You're…

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text: You say it's for the fans, but to me it just sounds like an excuse to escape from the reality that we can't win!

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text: Truth be told, I'm still not fully on board with everything. But…

text_block_list.name: Assembled Student C
text_block_list.text: And I want to tell them that I'm not done yet! That no matter how many times I lose, I have a goal, and I won't give up on it no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: The Grand Concert is not so noble. Rather, it is an arena where egos clash—yours and your fans'!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Use it not for your fans, but for yourself—for the sake of broadening your own potential!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I want to see all of you shining on stage at the Grand Concert as the stars of the show!

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text: Maybe I'm just looking to run away… but if the Grand Concert really is a space where we can be selfish…

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text: And I know this is really, really, self-centered, but there's something I want my fans to know.

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text: I want to tell them that even if I haven't been able to get a win, I haven't given up either, so please don't give up on me!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Your words will reach them! I know they will, so, um…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: I want you to say everything you have to say, then look at all your fans' faces, and get excited to sing with a smile again!

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text: …Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hello! Would you mind if, you know…

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: …Say no more. We'd greatly appreciate your help.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: We're all coming from different places, with different motives and different feelings to convey—it wouldn't be the Grand Concert otherwise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All of a sudden, it feels like we're surrounded by students and fans wanting to help out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Together, we spread the word about our project until the sun sets.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: …To think our supporters would reach six digits. Truly a massive figure.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Yes, and I'm so grateful for it! To all of you students, and to our fans too!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: As a researcher, I have much to be grateful for as well—the data set will be more than sufficient.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: But a reality check is in order. Now that we have all these supporters…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: We can't seriously expect they'll all be able to participate, can we?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The more people we get, the harder it'll be to organize the actual event.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Is there even a venue with the necessary capacity?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: We'll make do. I promise I'll find a way!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: We've come this far. I refuse to believe we have to give up on our vision!

text_block_list.name: Sound Staff
text_block_list.text: No need to put it all on yourself. I'll ask around about a venue.

text_block_list.name: Lighting Staff
text_block_list.text: We've come this far together. Might as well see it through.

text_block_list.name: Technical Staff
text_block_list.text: We're all tried and true fans of yours now!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: You guys…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hey, so I might've just had a genius idea! What if we… turned this into a whole festival?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: A festival?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah! If we can't all fit into one venue, why not get more venues?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: We could have different stages, like A, B, and C, and then fans could go wherever their favs are performing!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: And to top it all off, we could do a livestream of the whole event too. Each stage will be different, but…

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Everyone will get to have fun! And the scale of it will get people hyped up!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I see… That does sound like a genius idea!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Right? I even have a location in mind already…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Bzzt, bzzt!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …Whose phone is that?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Sorry, that's me. I'll call them back la—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Trainer, could I ask you to take over for a minute?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I'll be right back!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Light Hello runs off, leaving me in charge of molding Smart Falcon's ideas into a plan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We spend some time brainstorming with our trusty staff team, everyone chiming in to make the Grand Concert the best it can be.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That evening…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After seeing the students back to the academy, I finally hear from Light Hello.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Traineeer!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Sniffle… So this afternoon… the URA board came to observe us, and…

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: And… sniffle… and they said…

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: They said they'd offer their support for the Grand Concert…

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Uwaaaah! We… we did it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tears fall freely from Light Hello's eyes. All the days of hard work we've had together run through my mind.
choice_data_list: Well, sounds like we have work to do!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Yes! …Yes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We're just a few steps away from the Grand Concert.
